menu.label: AI for the selected text
menu.shortcut: Open the AI menu for the selected text

commands.improve: AI: rewrite the selected text more clearly
commands.suggest-links: AI: suggest links for the selected text
commands.suggest-tags: AI: suggest tags for the selected text

reasons.unavailable: AI isn't ready on the server
reasons.disabled: Turn on AI in Settings to use this
reasons.no-consent: You just changed the AI provider. Open Settings, under AI, and press Review and agree.
reasons.no-key: Add an API key in Settings to use AI
reasons.budget: This month's AI limit is used up
reasons.out-of-scope: This note is outside the folders AI may read
reasons.no-selection: Select some text to use AI
reasons.too-long: The selected text is too long for AI
reasons.source-mode: Leave source mode to use AI
reasons.read-only: This note can't be edited right now

blocked.unavailable: AI isn't ready on the server. Try again in a few minutes.
blocked.disabled: AI is off. You can turn it on in Settings, under AI.
blocked.no-consent: You just changed the AI provider. Open Settings, under AI, and press Review and agree.
blocked.no-key: AI in the app needs an API key: add one in Settings, under AI. Or use your Claude account through Claude Desktop: see Connect Claude in Settings.
blocked.budget: This month's limit is used up ({{limit}} tokens). Raise the limit in Settings or wait for next month.
blocked.out-of-scope: This note is outside the folders AI may read, so nothing was sent. You choose these folders in Settings, under AI.
blocked.no-selection: Select some text in the note, then try again.
blocked.too-long: The selected text is too long (at most {{max}} characters). Select less, then try again.
blocked.source-mode: Leave source mode and select some text to use AI.
blocked.read-only: This note can't be edited right now, so AI can't insert anything.

errors.network: Can't reach {{provider}}. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.timeout: {{provider}} took too long to answer. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.auth: The API key is wrong or has expired. Check it in Settings.
errors.rate-limit: {{provider}} is limiting requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.quota: Your {{provider}} account is out of quota or credit. Check the account, then try again.
errors.bad-request: {{provider}} didn't accept this request. Try selecting shorter text.
errors.server: {{provider}} has a problem right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.malformed: The AI answer wasn't in a usable form. Try again.
errors.invalid-answer: AI proposed something that isn't in your notes, so it was dropped. Try again.
errors.not-a-note: AI works on Markdown notes (.md) only.
errors.not-in-inbox: This note is no longer directly in the Inbox.
errors.not-utf8: This note isn't UTF-8 text, so AI can't read it.
errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check that Second Brain is running, then try again.
errors.emptyAnswer: AI had no answer for this text. Try again or select other text.
errors.generic: AI couldn't answer. Try again later.

panel.label: AI result for the selected text
panel.sentTo: The selected text was sent to {{provider}}.
panel.sentLinks: The selected text and a few excerpts of related notes were sent to {{provider}}.
panel.sentTags: The selected text and the list of tags you use were sent to {{provider}}.
panel.sentHybrid: The selected text was also sent to {{provider}} to search by meaning.
panel.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and press Ctrl+C.
panel.stale: The selected text just changed. Select it again and ask AI once more.

links.empty: AI found no note worth linking to.

tags.empty: AI has no tag to suggest.
tags.already: The note already has these tags.
tags.unreadable: The note's properties can't be read, so no tag was added. Fix them in source mode, then try again.
tags.failed: Couldn't add the tags. Try again later.

inbox.title: Tidy the Inbox with AI
inbox.intro: AI reads the note you press Suggest for and proposes a folder and a clearer name. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
inbox.sends: Pressing Suggest sends that note's text, the folder names and the names of a few related notes to {{provider}}.
inbox.sendsHybrid: That note's text is also sent to {{provider}} to search by meaning.
inbox.oneIntro: AI proposes a folder and a clearer name for this note. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
inbox.oneSent: This note, the folder names and the names of a few related notes were sent to {{provider}} to suggest a place.
inbox.oneSentHybrid: This note was also sent to {{provider}} to search by meaning.
inbox.outOfScope: The Inbox is outside the folders AI may read, so nothing is sent. You choose these folders in Settings, under AI.
inbox.empty: Inbox is clear. Press Alt+Q to capture anything, anytime.
inbox.busy: AI is busy with another note
inbox.keep: AI thinks this note is fine in the Inbox.
